assets.title: Crimson close-up
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: original restaurant food photography for a Bold & Dramatic style catalog, one final photograph only.
Style/medium: photorealistic high-end commercial food photograph with bold extravagant set art direction but authentic small-restaurant food and realistic physical materials. Square composition; produce 1254x1254 pixels if supported, otherwise native square.
Constraints: normal plausible portion, physically accurate food and shadows, real imperfections and honest edible texture. The complete serving and its container are fully visible with about 10% breathing room to all image edges. No text, no logo, no watermark, no collage or UI. No extra food scattered as decoration, no floating or exploding ingredients, no flames, no smoke or steam, no plastic gloss, no impossible cheese pulls, no additional dishes, no cutlery.
Scene/backdrop: rich saturated crimson red seamless tabletop and backdrop forming a loud monochrome red scene.
Subject: exactly one normal single-patty cheeseburger with lettuce and pickle and a single slice of melted cheese, sitting in a plain paper-lined low tray. Ordinary handmade burger proportions; no towering stack.
Composition/framing: tight eye-level food portrait; entire burger, paper, and tray visible; subject prominent.
Lighting/mood: hard raking side light with a strong dark physically grounded shadow. Dramatic confident commercial photograph.
Color/textures: neutral, naturally appetizing food colors, browned patty crust, slightly irregular toasted bun and honestly textured lettuce. Strong red is the environment only; sharply honest food texture, no artificial sheen.
assets.inspection: Usable: one single-patty cheeseburger, lettuce and pickle, fully visible paper-lined tray, red scene and physical shadow. Side margin is about 6–7%, tighter than the requested approximate 10%; no cropping.
